device.note: Video device index of the USB HDMI capture card. Find it with `gametrainer --list-devices`. Reassign per machine, or override with --device.

capture.note: width/height/fps/fourcc are requested from the capture card (MJPG lets 1080p60 fit over USB). downscale_width, process_every_n_frames and detect_scale are machine limits: they can only make a game profile lighter, never heavier.

ports.note: No network ports are used - capture is local over USB.
